MATCH (n:Dataset) WHERE n.urn IN $urnList WITH n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]->(child) RETURN n, count(child) as childCount

CALL { MATCH (n:Dataset) RETURN n UNION MATCH (n:Container) RETURN n } WITH n ORDER BY n.displayName SKIP $skip LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]->(child) RETURN n, count(child) as childCount

MATCH (a)-[r:DERIVES_FROM|FLOWS_TO]->(b) RETURN a.urn AS src, b.urn AS tgt, type(r) AS relType, properties(r) AS rprops SKIP $skip LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Dataset)-[r:DERIVES_FROM]->(b) WHERE a.urn IN $anchorUrns RETURN a.urn AS src, b.urn AS tgt, type(r) AS relType, properties(r) AS rprops LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p)-[r]->(c) WHERE p.urn = $parent AND type(r) IN $relTypes WITH c ORDER BY c.displayName, c.urn SKIP $skip LIMIT $lim OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[rc]->(gc) WHERE type(rc) IN $relTypes RETURN c, count(gc) as childCount

MATCH (p)-[r]->(c) WHERE p.urn = $parent AND type(r) IN $relTypes AND (c.displayName > $cursorName OR (c.displayName = $cursorName AND c.urn > $cursorUrn)) WITH c ORDER BY c.displayName, c.urn LIMIT $lim OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[rc]->(gc) WHERE type(rc) IN $relTypes RETURN c, count(gc) as childCount

MATCH (p:Domain)-[r:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]->(c) WHERE p.urn = $parent WITH p, r, c ORDER BY c.displayName, c.urn SKIP $skip LIMIT $lim OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[rc:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]->(gc) RETURN c, count(gc) as childCount, p.urn as parentUrn, type(r) as relType, properties(r) as rprops

MATCH (n) WHERE NOT (n)<-[:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]-() WITH n ORDER BY n.displayName ASC, n.urn ASC LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]->(child) WITH n, count(child) as childCount ORDER BY n.displayName ASC, n.urn ASC RETURN n, childCount
MATCH (n) WHERE NOT (n)<-[:CONTAINS|HAS_PART]-() RETURN count(n) as total

MATCH (f)<-[r:AGGREGATED]-(other) WHERE f.urn IN $frontier AND labels(other)[0] = 'unknown' AND (r.sourceEdgeTypes IS NULL OR any(et IN r.sourceEdgeTypes WHERE et IN $ltypes)) WITH other.urn AS sourceUrn, f.urn AS targetUrn, id(r) AS edgeId, type(r) AS edgeType, COALESCE(r.sourceEdgeTypes, [type(r)]) AS edgeTypes, COALESCE(r.weight, 1) AS weight, other AS otherNode ORDER BY weight DESC RETURN sourceUrn, targetUrn, edgeId, edgeType, edgeTypes, weight, otherNode LIMIT $limit

MATCH (f)-[r:AGGREGATED]->(other) WHERE f.urn IN $frontier AND labels(other)[0] = 'unknown' AND (r.sourceEdgeTypes IS NULL OR any(et IN r.sourceEdgeTypes WHERE et IN $ltypes)) WITH f.urn AS sourceUrn, other.urn AS targetUrn, id(r) AS edgeId, type(r) AS edgeType, COALESCE(r.sourceEdgeTypes, [type(r)]) AS edgeTypes, COALESCE(r.weight, 1) AS weight, other AS otherNode ORDER BY weight DESC RETURN sourceUrn, targetUrn, edgeId, edgeType, edgeTypes, weight, otherNode LIMIT $limit

MATCH (s)-[r]->(t) WHERE s.urn IN $sUrns AND t.urn IN $tUrns   AND type(r) IN $ltypes RETURN s.urn AS sUrn, t.urn AS tUrn, type(r) AS edgeType, id(r) AS edgeId, properties(r) AS props LIMIT $limit

MATCH (s:Dataset)-[r]->(t) WHERE s.urn IN $sourceUrns AND type(r) IN $ltypes AND s.urn <> t.urn RETURN s.urn AS sUrn, t.urn AS tUrn, count(r) AS weight, collect(DISTINCT type(r)) AS types

UNWIND $batch AS item MERGE (n:Domain {urn: item.urn}) SET n.displayName = item.displayName, n.qualifiedName = item.qualifiedName, n.description = item.description, n.tags = item.tags, n.layerAssignment = item.layerAssignment, n.childCount = item.childCount, n.sourceSystem = item.sourceSystem, n.lastSyncedAt = item.lastSyncedAt, n.propertiesRaw = item.propertiesRaw, n.level = coalesce(item.level, n.level), n.searchableText = item.searchableText, n += item.nativeProps REMOVE n.properties

UNWIND $batch AS item MERGE (n:Dataset {urn: item.urn}) SET n.displayName = item.displayName, n.qualifiedName = item.qualifiedName, n.description = item.description, n.tags = item.tags, n.layerAssignment = item.layerAssignment, n.childCount = item.childCount, n.sourceSystem = item.sourceSystem, n.lastSyncedAt = item.lastSyncedAt, n.propertiesRaw = item.propertiesRaw, n.level = coalesce(item.level, n.level), n.searchableText = item.searchableText, n += item.nativeProps REMOVE n.properties
UNWIND $batch AS item MATCH (a:Domain {urn: item.src}) MATCH (b:Dataset {urn: item.tgt}) MERGE (a)-[r:CONTAINS]->(b) SET r.id = item.eid, r.confidence = item.conf, r.properties = item.props
UNWIND $batch AS item MATCH (a:Dataset {urn: item.src}) MATCH (b:Dataset {urn: item.tgt}) MERGE (a)-[r:DERIVES_FROM]->(b) SET r.id = item.eid, r.confidence = item.conf, r.properties = item.props

MATCH (a {urn: $src}) MATCH (b {urn: $tgt})
                    MERGE (a)-[r:CONTAINS]->(b)
                    SET r.id = $eid, r.confidence = $conf, r.properties = $props

MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.id = $eid SET r.properties = $props RETURN a.urn, b.urn, type(r), properties(r)
